recovery.instruction: Paths are rooted at the selected virtual project, not the operating-system workspace. Use a returned project path or installed public API inspection; do not invent filesystem prefixes.

Investigation has continued at the same project revision; new facts alone do not establish task progress. Identify the exact remaining external fact or conflicting instructions and why another read would resolve it. Reuse already resolved contracts; a missing project-owned file or behavior is implementation work, not proof of an unavailable API. When the required contracts are known, consider a small reversible implementation and validate it; otherwise continue relevant research or report the precise conflict. Same-run source observations remain recorded; edits still check current hashes. No permissions or verification results changed. This reminder does not require mutation or limit further calls.
